invariants: Preserve source identity, version, query and units; historical evidence never grants fresh-read or mutation authority.
Commit each returned pair once; preserve unknown outcomes and existing off/warn/pause choices.
Exactly measured model input and one batch reservation ledger remain authoritative.
existing: Semantic handoff owns bounded event attempts; WorkingContext persists them with existing windows.
BudgetBroker owns request reservations; archive and broker share response-contract constants.
doNotDuplicate: No second memory database or summary/judge model.
No extra context-token calculator or reservation ledger.
Do not redesign provider output status or auto-replay completed/unknown operations.
Use existing summaryEvidence, checkpoint generator, note validation and atomic window persistence.
validationPlan: Same semantic event never retried; a new eligible event may consume the remaining execution budget.
Timeout/invalid refs/output-limit preserve old note; abort/finalization suppress new model work.
Restore maintains event deduplication while new execution budgets do not inherit raw wall-clock deadlines.
Tiny envelopes/Unicode/escaping respect caps and expose actionable failures; held reservations settle once.
Initial proposal max 2 summary calls / 60 seconds combined / 3 completed rounds cooldown must be evaluated live, not claimed as validated.
